disposition_reason: Original AAS lead measurements in wheat flour bread bought in Cotonou, Bohicon and Parakou, Benin, with a consumer intake survey.
disposition_locator: Results and Figure 2, p. 17060; Discussion, p. 17061

study.design: Market sampling of the most-consumed bread type per city with a consumer survey and exposure estimate
study.market: Bakeries and sale points across Cotonou, Bohicon and Parakou, Benin (zonal distribution)
study.method: AAS after dry incineration per NF EN 14082

findings.material_label: Wheat flour bread ('batard' and sweet bread)
findings.notes: Combined mean for Cotonou ('batard' bread) and Parakou (sweet bread); three replicate breads per city. Basis not stated.
